title.zh: 将阿尔拜省Camalig市镇Ilawod国立中学更名为Camalig国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Ilawod National High School in Barangay Ilawod Municipality of Camalig, Province of Albay, to Camalig National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Ilawod National High School in Barangay Ilawod Municipality of Camalig, Province of Albay, to Camalig National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Ilawod tại Barangay Ilawod Municipality of Camalig, Tỉnh Albay thành Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Camalig
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Ilawod ในบารังไกย์ Ilawod Municipality of Camalig, จังหวัด Albay เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Camalig
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Ilawod di Barangay Ilawod Municipality of Camalig, Provinsi Albay menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Camalig
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Ilawod di Barangay Ilawod Municipality of Camalig, Wilayah Albay menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Camalig

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2021/ra_11532_2021.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Ilawod National High School in Barangay Ilawod, Municipality of Camalig, Province of Albay, is hereby changed to Camalig National High School.
The main campus of the Camalig National High School shall continue to remain in its present location in Barangay Ilawod, Municipality of Camalig, Province of Albay.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
